svg.title: Popular Scripting 0.2.29 preview
svg.desc: Fixture-only geometry evidence for four columns: circular icon, grouped name plus code and observation date, sparkline, and grouped right-aligned value, unit, and variation. The native name reservation is 27 pt, followed by 8 pt spacing, a 3 pt status dot, and 2 pt trailing room. Only USD/BRL has a timestamped curve; sparse sources say 24h indisponível.
svg.text: Prévia de dados de teste · quatro colunas 28/40/46/26 pt · nome 27 pt + espaço 8 pt + ponto 3 pt + folga 2 pt · sem alegação de render nativo/iPhone
